title: Sunday · the flats, first gray
venue: Arthur's site · the coastal weeklies · from 2017 the aggregator
logline: The pup's first February on the flats: the mud gray, the sky gray, the channels gray, and the pup the one dark thing in three tiers of gray, getting smaller as he goes out and larger as he comes back. Wet-on-wet.

panels.composition: Tier 1: gray flats wet-on-wet, a small three-legged dog going out, dark, small.

image.prompt: gray tidal mudflats painted wet-on-wet with a small three-legged dog going out as the one dark shape, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Out

panels.composition: Tier 2: grayer; the pup a dot at the tide line.

image.prompt: gray tidal mudflats wet-on-wet with a small three-legged dog as a dark dot at the distant tide line, watercolor

panels.name: Far

panels.composition: Tier 3: the pup coming back, large, mud to the chest, the gray behind him.

image.prompt: a small three-legged dog muddy to the chest coming toward the viewer large against gray wet-on-wet flats, watercolor, no words

panels.name: Back

art.line: razor-sharp brush and ink; the pup's weight learned; Sundays wet-on-wet
art.palette: dailies: ink and one tone. Sundays: gray-green, fog, rust, bruised dusk

notes: One dark thing in three tiers of gray.
